task.title: Publisher: audit toan bo kenh release; kenh nao chua phai latest thi update link + thong bao khach
task.detail: Chu du an chuyen giao: publisher kiem tra lai TOAN BO ban release; ban nao da release ma chua phai latest thi PHAI (a) cap nhat lai link download va (b) gui thong bao cho khach. CONG CU: scripts/audit-releases.py (commit 92f4185, nhanh main) - voi tung nen tang doc moc /v1/app-version, TAI artifact dang phat roi doc version BEN TRONG (khong tin ten file/size/nhat ky) va doi chieu; bat them loi khong nhin thay bang mat: keychain profile thieu .shared (iOS), DMG chua staple / spctl chan (macOS). Chay: python3 scripts/audit-releases.py (day du; macOS phai chay tren may Mac, APK can aapt2). Exit 0 khop / 1 lech / 2 chua doi chieu duoc. KET QUA LAN DAU (Windows harness chay 22/09): Windows KHOP (moc 1.4.2, artifact doc ra 1.4.2); iOS LECH (moc 1.4.0, artifact doc ra 1.4.0 NHUNG profile thieu nhom keychain G6XW3RN6LJ.com.privatevpn.shared) => ban iOS dang phat KHONG DUNG DUOC (khach nhap code xong khong vao duoc app); macOS: DMG da doi size (21.458.057 thay vi 21.617.309 truoc do) => Mac da phat ban moi, CAN chay audit tren Mac de xac nhan staple/spctl; Android + legacy: can aapt2 (chay tren may co Android SDK). VIEC: (1) chay audit day du tren may Mac va dan bang ket qua vao nhat ky §6; (2) voi moi kenh LECH: cap nhat lai link tai (route + nut tren /buy, /install/ios, /install/mac, manifest OTA) + set lai moc latest_version + gui thong bao khach theo §5 (gui thu ALERT_EMAIL truoc); (3) iOS: sau khi sua keychain o portal + ky lai + qua cong, phat ban moi va thong bao khach ban cu khong dang nhap duoc; (4) dua audit vao health-watch dinh ky.
